thread:
marta: Quick check — onboarding a new on-prem customer and they say their OTLP exporter is hitting our VPC but their Grafana in the customer account shows only some dashboards. Where do we point them for tenant-specific dashboards + which alert rules typically need loosening for high-cardinality metrics?

alex: For dashboards: give them the tenant Grafana link + the folder ID. Usually it's `https://grafana.redwood-inference.com/d/tenant-<tenant_id>` (replace <tenant_id>). I can DM the exact folder if you share the tenant id.

sam: Regarding alerts, high-cardinality series (model.request.*) tend to spike. We usually relax `for` to 5m and bump the threshold by 20% during onboarding. Which alerts specifically?

marta: Thanks. Tenant id is acme-23. They forward metrics via Prometheus remote_write -> our Receiver (prom-remote). Also using OTLP for traces/logs. They report missing traces and some logs not appearing in Loki.

ops-oncall: Quick checklist: 1) confirm `remote_write` endpoint and creds (promtail/opentelemetry exporter). 2) check tenant routing label is present (`tenant=acme-23`). 3) confirm prom-remote didn't reject samples due to series limit.

marta: I can confirm they have `remote_write` -> `https://prom-remote.prod.vpc.redwood/scrape/acme-23` and basic auth token. How do I check rejections?

sre-bot: deploybot: prom-remote logs for acme-23 show 2.3k series rejected in last 10m due to per-tenant series cap. See logs: `ERROR: series_limit_exceeded: dropped 2300 samples`

alex: If that's the case, we either raise acme-23 series cap temporarily or advise them to reduce cardinality (label drop, relabeling). I can open a temp cap request if you want — will need approval from infra.

marta: Please do, open request and tag me. Meanwhile, where are the tenant dashboards for tracing? They expect to see span waterfall + service map.

jamie: Traces live in Tempo (OTLP). Tenant view is accessible from Grafana via the Tempo datasource. Dashboard link: `https://grafana.redwood-inference.com/d/tempo-tenant-view?orgId=1&var-tenant=acme-23`. If traces aren't coming, check OTLP endpoint metrics: `otlp.receiver.exports_total{tenant="acme-23"}`

sam: For Loki logs, confirm promtail/otelcol sends to our Loki push gateway with `tenant` label. Quick grep on promtail config: ```yaml
clients:
  - url: https://loki-ingest.vpc.redwood/api/prom/push
    tenant: acme-23
```

marta: I don't have access to their promtail config, only what they shared. They say `tenant` is present. Any quick debugging query to check ingestion?

ops-oncall: In Grafana Explore -> Loki, run `| tenant="acme-23" |~"ERROR|WARN"` or look at `loki_ingester_ingested_samples_total{tenant="acme-23"}` metric in our Prometheus. If ingested_samples_total is zero, then nothing reached our ingestion layer.

alex: I opened the series cap escalation ticket: #INC-7452, requested temporary +30% cap for acme-23. Tagged @infra on it. If approved, that should reduce rejections immediately.

marta: Awesome. Last bits: can someone review my quick PR that adds the dashboard link + alert tuning notes to our onboarding playbook? PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/onboarding/pull/412 

sam: I'll take a look in ~30m. If I can't merge, ping @alex for a quick review.

ops-oncall: Also, set a short-term rule: silence the `HighCardinality` alert for acme-23 while they stabilize. Use `silence-id: acme-23-onboard` with expiry 72h.

marta: Got it. I'll create the silence once infra approves the cap. Thanks all :thumbsup:

sre-bot: note: infra approved temporary cap increase for acme-23, applied. Monitor `series_rejection_total` over next 15m.

marta: Seeing rejections drop in the dashboard now. Will follow up if traces still missing. Thanks everyone.

jamie: If traces still missing after 15m, ask them to share OTLP exporter debug logs (level=debug) and I'll grep for `failed to send` entries.
